title: Secure and Reliable Quantum Information Networks
support_statement: $700 per week ($7,000 over ten weeks), fully covered on-campus housing, and travel to and from the Illinois Urbana-Champaign campus. Occasional meals are provided.
eligibility_statement: The program is designed for students pursuing an undergraduate degree. Final 2027 eligibility requirements, including any citizenship or residency conditions tied to funding, will be published with the application.
funding_statement: The 2027 program is confirmed regardless of the NSF funding decision. A proposal has been submitted to NSF; funding has not been announced.

mentors.name: Daniel Alabi
mentors.bio: Leads the secure communications thrust and the overall program. His research connects algorithms, privacy, cryptography, and information theory. He oversees project integration, recruitment, and the student research experience.

mentors.name: Eric Chitambar
mentors.bio: Leads the distributed quantum consensus thrust and shares program leadership. He mentors research on quantum information, communication, position verification, and nonlocal computation.

mentors.name: Olgica Milenkovic
mentors.bio: Leads projects on quantum error correction, noise models, and decoding. Her mentoring connects coding and information theory with exact enumeration, algorithm design, and reproducible computation.

mentors.name: Milad Marvian
mentors.bio: Contributes expertise in quantum information theory, control, error correction, and distributed quantum processing. His program mentoring spans position verification, consensus, and quantum error correction.

housing_statement: Fully covered, suite-style housing in an on-campus residence hall, with a private bedroom and a shared living room and kitchen.
accommodations_statement: Appropriate accommodations will be made for students with disabilities. Contact program coordination to discuss access needs and plan for your participation.

application_timeline.event: Application support and office hours; details forthcoming

social_activities: Coffee chats with graduate students and REU alumni
